% Pattern: number/class. A class puts a command before the theorem number,
% which is empty unless an option is on, as \siamprelabel of siamart.cls.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 3
\documentclass{journalart}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
